{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check if the groups are comparable by cross-tabulating channel with other variables
# Specifically, check if customer_segment or customer_age differs systematically between channels

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment
crosstab_segment = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment'])

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_age (use bins to see distribution)
df['age_group'] = pd.cut(df['customer_age'], bins=[0, 30, 50, 100], labels=['Young', 'Middle-aged', 'Old'])
crosstab_age = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['age_group'])

# Print crosstabs to check for systematic differences
print("Cross-tabulation: channel vs customer_segment")
print(crosstab_segment)
print("\nCross-tabulation: channel vs age_group")
print(crosstab_age)"}
